title: E0051: Count of a non-countable value
plain_english: `count()` and `sizeof()` work on arrays and on objects that implement `Countable`. Passing a string, number, boolean, or `null` causes a `TypeError` in PHP 8.
why_matters: The code fails at runtime instead of returning a length, which can break a request, job, or CLI command.
bad_example:
count('hello'); // TypeError
sizeof(42);     // TypeError
count(null);    // TypeError
good_example:
count($items);       // $items is an array
sizeof($collection); // $collection implements Countable
strlen($text);       // use strlen() for strings
what_it_checks: `count()` or `sizeof()` with an integer or float literal
`count()` or `sizeof()` with a boolean or `null` literal
